gpx_dialog_delete_past_upload_body: This removes the upload from your history and permanently deletes every memory that was created from it, including linked photos, videos, and audio. You cannot undo this.
gpx_ignore_snackbar_need_file: Choose a KMZ file first, then tap +.
gpx_ignore_help_body: Ignore rules tell the importer which placemarks or track points to skip, using marker style, color, or timestamps from your KMZ. Your original file on the phone is never changed—matching items are simply left out of preview counts and import. After adding or editing a rule, tap Preview so totals stay accurate.
gpx_help_max_time_apart_body: Memories are built by merging nearby stops or photos into clusters. Two items can merge only if both are within this time limit and within your maximum distance. A shorter limit keeps clusters tighter in time; preview and import always use the same values.
gpx_help_max_meter_apart_body: This is how far apart stops or photos may be on the map while still counting as one memory, together with the time limit. Lower numbers split routes into more memories; higher numbers join farther-apart places into fewer memories.
gpx_help_memory_start_date_body: Anything recorded before this calendar day is skipped in preview and will not be imported. Use it to drop older legs of a trip or junk at the beginning of a track.
gpx_help_memory_end_date_body: Anything recorded after this day is skipped in preview and import. Combine it with the start date so only the slice of your timeline you care about is imported.
